name: rexpipe
description: AI-native regex pipeline processor for text transformation, pattern matching, and data processing

tools.name: rexpipe_substitute
tools.description: Replace text matching a regex pattern with a replacement string. Supports capture groups ($1, $2, etc.) in replacement.

global.description: Replace all occurrences (true) or just the first (false)

tools.name: rexpipe_filter
tools.description: Filter lines of text based on a regex pattern. Can keep or drop matching lines.

text.description: The text to filter (line by line)

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match against each line

keep.description: If true, keep matching lines. If false, drop matching lines.

tools.name: rexpipe_extract
tools.description: Extract text matching a regex pattern. Returns all matches found in the input.

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match. Use capture groups to extract specific parts.

capture_group.description: Which capture group to return (0 = entire match, 1+ = specific groups)

tools.name: rexpipe_validate
tools.description: Validate that text matches a pattern. Returns validation result with details about any failures.

pattern.description: Regex pattern that text should match

require_all_lines.description: If true, all lines must match. If false, any matching line is valid.

tools.name: rexpipe_transform
tools.description: Apply text transformations: uppercase, lowercase, trim, reverse, snake_case, camelCase, etc.

pattern.description: Optional: only transform text matching this pattern

tools.name: rexpipe_pipeline
tools.description: Execute a multi-step processing pipeline defined in TOML format. Most powerful option for complex transformations.

pipeline.description: Pipeline configuration in TOML format with [[steps]] sections

tools.name: rexpipe_redact_pii
tools.description: Redact personally identifiable information (PII) from text: emails, phone numbers, SSNs, credit cards, IP addresses.

text.description: The text to redact PII from

types.description: Which types of PII to redact

tools.name: rexpipe_detect_secrets
tools.description: Detect potential secrets, API keys, and credentials in text. Returns locations and types of detected secrets.

text.description: The text to scan for secrets

types.description: Which types of secrets to detect

resources.name: Common Patterns
resources.description: Frequently-used regex patterns: email, URL, UUID, IP address, dates, etc.

resources.name: Log Patterns
resources.description: Patterns for parsing Apache, nginx, syslog, JSON logs, and stack traces.

resources.name: AI Agent Patterns
resources.description: Patterns for AI workflows: PII, secrets, code extraction, data cleaning, validation.

prompts.name: redact_pii
prompts.description: Redact all PII from the provided text

prompts.name: extract_code
prompts.description: Extract code blocks from markdown-formatted text

prompts.name: clean_text
prompts.description: Normalize and clean text: fix whitespace, remove control characters, standardize line endings
